name: discovery-design-001
selection: Every nonempty Feynman metadata row with one to three variables; no outcome exclusions
noise_scale: standard deviation of clean pool outputs; known only to evaluator
metric: test MSE divided by clean test variance; floor 1e-8 only when computing log ratios
claim_boundary: A bounded experimental-design result, not symbolic recovery, new physical laws, autonomous science, or state of the art
